problem: In any nondegenerate triangle a greater angle is subtended by the greater side.

proof_idea.original: If the opposite side were equal or smaller, the isosceles base-angle theorem or I.18 would contradict the greater angle.
proof_idea.analytic: Same source dichotomy: equal squared sides give equal angle measures via verified isosceles dot/congruence interfaces; smaller side invokes I.18 with swapped vertices.

litex_code:
# Book I.19: a greater triangle angle has the greater opposite side.
thm proposition_19:
    ? forall a, b, c cart(R, R):
        a != b
        a != c
        b != c
        $geometry::main::is_triangle(a, b, c)
        ray_angle(a, b, c) > ray_angle(a, c, b)
        =>:
            geometry::main::distance_sq(a, c) > geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b)
    by contra:
        ? geometry::main::distance_sq(a, c) > geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b)
        geometry::main::distance_sq(a, c) <= geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b)
        by cases:
            ? ray_angle(a, b, c) <= ray_angle(a, c, b)
            case geometry::main::distance_sq(a, c) = geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b):
                geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b) = geometry::main::distance_sq(a, c)
                release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_symmetric(a, b)
                release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_symmetric(a, c)
                release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_symmetric(b, c)
                geometry::main::distance_sq(b, a) = geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b) = geometry::main::distance_sq(a, c) = geometry::main::distance_sq(c, a)
                release thm geometry::main::isosceles_base_dot(a, b, c)
                release thm accepted::angle_congruence_from_equal_sides_and_dot(b, a, c, c, a, b)
                by thm angle_relation_implies_equal_measure(a, b, c, a, c, b) => ray_angle(a, b, c) = ray_angle(a, c, b)
                ray_angle(a, b, c) <= ray_angle(a, c, b)
            case geometry::main::distance_sq(a, c) < geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b):
                by def $geometry::main::is_triangle(a, b, c)
                release thm geometry::main::det_antisymmetric(geometry::main::vec(a, c), geometry::main::vec(a, b))
                by contra:
                    ? geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, c), geometry::main::vec(a, b)) != 0
                    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, c), geometry::main::vec(a, b)) = 0
                    -geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c)) = 0
                    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c)) = -(-geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c))) = -0 = 0
                    impossible geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c)) != 0
                by def $geometry::main::is_triangle(a, c, b)
                release thm proposition_18(a, c, b)
                ray_angle(a, b, c) < ray_angle(a, c, b)
                ray_angle(a, b, c) <= ray_angle(a, c, b)
        impossible ray_angle(a, b, c) > ray_angle(a, c, b)
